text: This report recommends approving a contract with Tony Battista Paving Inc. ("Battista") for Asphalt and Concrete Repair Services on an as required basis at various locations on Exhibition Place grounds, for a period of one (1) year, with an option to renew for an additional three (3) years. The Request for Quotation was issued on December 9, 2024, through Exhibition Place Purchasing Department via Bonfire Online Procurement System, and prices per linear meter on various type of work were obtained from a number of vendors. The recommendation is to award the contract to the lowest compliant bidder meeting Request for Quotation requirements and specifications within the available budget. This project is both time and weather sensitive and to meet construction timelines, as well as, to leverage window of opportunity available during between scheduled events. The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved a contract with Tony Battista Paving Inc. for asphalt and concrete repair services at various locations on Exhibition Place grounds for a one-year term, with an estimated annual amount of up to $250,000 (excluding HST) based on projected and historical requirements with an option to renew for an additional three (3) years on the terms and conditions set out in the report (January 21, 2025) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place and such other terms and conditions required by the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place and the City Solicitor.
